# KaTeX 0.18.7 browser runtime

`katex.min.js` is copied unchanged from `katex@0.18.7` on npm and served from
Vite's public directory under the deployment asset base. The platform loads it
on demand and requests MathML-only output, so the KaTeX stylesheet and fonts
are not shipped.

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.18.7
